title: VCs will make billions on Anthropic’s IPO, but Amazon is set to make much (much) more
script:
Amazon is set to make billions more than venture capitalists from Anthropic.
Massive note conversions revealed the true extent of Amazon ownership in the lab behind Claude.
Chief Executive Officer Dario Amodei built the AI model that powered these investments.
Those earlier billions convert into a massive payout during the upcoming public offering.
TechCrunch reported that venture firms will make billions too, but the cloud giant claims the lion share.
Will cloud providers completely dominate the next wave of AI startups?
Would you buy shares in Amazon right now?
